paper.title_en: Global tensor polarization of spin-3/2 hadrons and quark spin correlations in relativistic heavy-ion collisions
paper.abstract_en: This talk summarizes our study of global polarization of spin-3/2 hadrons in relativistic heavy ion collisions. Within the quark combination model, we demonstrated how to calculate the spin density matrix of final-state hadrons and established connections between hadron polarization components and quark spin correlations. We showed that the rank-2 and rank-3 tensor polarizations of spin-3/2 hadrons are sensitive to local two-quark and three-quark spin correlations respectively. We also summarized the measurement methods for these polarization components via the angular distributions of decay products.
